Run built-in insights over a period: each one's summary, and its value in every bucket of the
period.

An insight is named by its id (mrr, churn_rate or churn-rate) or its name ("Churn rate"); 'voidhash
insights list' shows them. The period is the last 30 complete days in UTC unless --last or --from
says otherwise. Purchases of production are counted unless --environment says otherwise.

Usage:
  voidhash insights run [insight...] [flags]

Arguments:
  insight  Insights to run, such as mrr or "trial conversion rate"

Flags:
      --by <hour|day|week|month|quarter|year>
                           Bucket width of the series (default: by the period's length)
      --compare            Also run the period of the same length before it
      --environment <production|sandbox|test|all>
                           Purchases counted: production, sandbox (App Store and Google Play
                           sandbox), test (debug builds' simulated purchases and test modes such as
                           Stripe's) or all (default: production)
      --from <day>         First day to report on, YYYY-MM-DD (instead of --last)
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API results as JSON, for scripts
      --last <span>        The complete days before today to report on: a span such as 7d, 4w, 3m or
                           1y (default: 30d)
      --product <product>  Only purchases of this product: its slug, name or id; repeat for each
                           (can be repeated)
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
      --to <day>           Last day to report on, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today; with --from)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash insights run mrr
  voidhash insights run mrr churn-rate --last 90d --by week
  voidhash insights run revenue --from 2026-10-01 --to 2026-10-31 --compare
  voidhash insights run new-subscriptions --product pro-monthly --json
